meta.rules_at_freeze: auto-match only when exactly one PO is found by exact PO ref (vendor and total within tolerance, same currency) or by exact normalised vendor + total within tolerance + date window, same currency. Everything else is AMBIGUOUS or UNMATCHED. Tolerance max(2%,1.00). Eval counts any needs_review as flagged.
